image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a green snake, identified as a green mamba, resting on a textured brown branch. The snake's head is the primary focus, showing detailed scale texture and a large dark eye. The body curves out of frame to the left. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape in the image appears somewhat blunt and rounded at the snout, lacking the distinct 'coffin-shaped' narrowness and sharp angularity typical of a mamba. The brow ridge is not prominently defined in the way described for this species.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible, large, dark, and appears to have a round pupil, consistent with diurnal snakes like mambas.
The visible portion of the body behind the head is slender and cylindrical/elongated, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) side of the snake is not visible in this angle; the snake is draped over the branch showing mostly dorsal/lateral views.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform green coloration with no patterning.
